description.html: This dish is wide and very shallow, with a flat bottom and a wavy, rounded rim that looks like the shore of a small pool. The light sand color with a fine texture almost blends in with light sand and beige substrates.

The shallow depth is its main feature. For gecko and bearded dragon hatchlings, shallow water is safer because they cannot get stuck or slip in deep water. The wide, flat bottom is also handy for serving food: insects, chopped vegetables or greens stay in one place, and your animal can easily see and reach them.
The light color has another advantage: dirt, food leftovers and droppings show up right away, so you know when it is time to clean.

Because it is so shallow, the water evaporates quickly, especially in a warm desert terrarium. Check and top it up during the day and change it every morning. Place the dish on a level surface on the cooler side, and wash the wavy rim easily with a soft sponge.
